title: SecureClaw: Clawing Back Control of LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.09549v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents face two distinct security failures: unauthorized external actions and exposure of sensitive plaintext inside the runtime before any final output check can intervene. Existing defenses usually protect one boundary, either the planner/runtime or the point where external actions are executed, and therefore do not by themselves secure both surfaces. We present SecureClaw, a dual-boundary architecture that enforces authorization in a trusted executor and keeps raw protected data outside the LLM runtime. Sensitive reads pass through a trusted gateway that replaces raw values with reference IDs. In the evaluated deployment, the gateway also provides short planning summaries that deliberately release selected information, a process called declassification. translated_title: SecureClaw：夺回对大语言模型智能体的控制
translated_abstract: 使用工具的大语言模型（LLM）智能体面临两种不同的安全失效：未经授权的外部操作，以及敏感明文在任何最终输出检查介入之前就在运行时内部暴露。现有防御通常只保护一个边界——要么是规划器/运行时，要么是执行外部操作的位置——因此其本身无法同时保护这两个层面。我们提出SecureClaw，这是一种双边界架构，它在可信执行器中强制执行授权，并将原始受保护数据保留在LLM运行时之外。敏感读取通过一个可信网关进行，该网关用引用ID替换原始值。在所评估的部署中，网关还提供简短的规划摘要，有意释放被选定的信息，这一过程称为去分类化。改变外部状态的写操作遵循PREVIEW→COMMIT（预览→提交）协议，其中只有可信执行器可以执行确切的…
tldr: SecureClaw提出了一种双边界安全架构，通过可信执行器强制授权、以引用ID替代敏感明文、以及PREVIEW→COMMIT写操作协议，同时防御LLM智能体的未授权外部操作和运行时敏感数据泄露这两类安全风险。
en_tdlr: SecureClaw introduces a dual-boundary architecture that enforces authorization in a trusted executor, replaces sensitive plaintext with reference IDs via a trusted gateway, and adopts a PREVIEW→COMMIT protocol for state-changing writes, jointly defending LLM agents against both unauthorized external actions and runtime exposure of sensitive data.
